expansion_rationale: This is a global B2B specialty-coffee operations and food-safety directory opportunity. The keyword set prioritizes searchable safety records, import refusals, RASFF data, origin risk, supplier due diligence, and compliance, while adding operational modifiers relevant to micro-roasters, café roasters, wholesale teams, subscriptions, and cooperatives. It deliberately avoids the already-covered broad seed “green coffee” and the invented solution name, instead using category language such as database, directory, records, alerts, and risk assessment.
